note: An invented page of five blocks (an allotment planting plan) for the picker to walk. Ids are part ids as a page would carry them; one block repeats with a key.

blocks.heading: Plot 14 planting plan
blocks.text: Two rows of raised beds, a compost bay and a water butt. This plan says what grows where this year.

blocks.heading: North beds
blocks.text: Bed 1 onions, bed 2 garlic, bed 3 leeks (2.4 m).

blocks.heading: South beds
blocks.text: Bed 4 beans on a frame, bed 5 squash, bed 6 left fallow under cardboard.

blocks.heading: Sowing calendar
blocks.text: Garlic: October to November. Onion sets: March. Peas: March to June.

blocks.heading: Note
blocks.text: The tap by the gate freezes first; use the water butt in a cold spell.
